name: MNR Launcher Panel
_comment_install_type: scriptui_panel. Installs into the After Effects install folder (Support Files/Scripts/ScriptUI Panels), which is the only location a dockable panel reliably loads from. That path needs a UAC prompt.
notes: MNR_Launcher_Panel.jsx is the real panel. MNR_Feature_Catalog.jsx is a showroom of every ScriptUI widget and a wide spread of AE scripting actions, each numbered, used to decide what the real panel should contain. Not intended to ship to artists.
